_about: Desk banter for the newsroom: short exchanges between segments, the running bits with Batty and Pip, and cast birthdays and anniversaries.
Everything here is fixed text. Nothing is written live by an AI, and the news refresh never touches this file.
who: A Rosa, B Marcus, P Evelyn, W Sunny, S Bo, I Teo, L Jess, X Juniper. Every exchange has two lines.
{name} and {first} fill in the person a birthday is for. In anniversaries, {years} {yearWord} reads like "2 years". by: who says each line.

Banter is skipped next to a serious story: any segment listed in alwaysSerious, or any story with one of the seriousWords in it (a word ending in * also matches longer forms: injur* matches injured and injuries).

lines.say: Jess has been out since the early shift. I'm told she's on her third coffee.
Fourth, Rosa. But who's counting? Besides the barista.
Rosa, did Jess ever find a parking spot?
She says she found one. She also says she's not telling us where.
Quick note for the desk: somebody left a sandwich in the news van. It's been there a while.
That would be Marcus. We'll deal with it after the show.
Sunny, before you start: I wore a coat today. Was that the right call?
Marcus, you wear a coat every day. You wore one in July.
I've got a brand new map today. Well, it's the old map. I cleaned it.
It does look very clean, Sunny.
Sunny, is it true you name every cloud on the map?
Only the nice ones. The grumpy ones know who they are.
Juniper, you have goggles on. Should we be worried?
Not worried, Rosa. Curious! There's a big difference.
Rosa, I brought a volcano model to share with the desk.
Let's keep it in the lab this time, Juniper. The carpet still remembers last time.
Juniper, how's the field trip bus holding up?
Wonderfully! It only made one strange noise this week, and that was a duck.
Bo, I hear you've been practicing your own highlight voice.
And he takes the mug. Fakes left. Sips. What a play, folks.
Rosa, I've got a stat for you: this desk has never lost a coin toss.
Bo, this desk has never done a coin toss.
Bo is wearing his lucky tie again.
It's undefeated, Rosa. Mostly because it doesn't play.
Marcus, I think you saved the best part of the day for last.
I always do. Just like the last cookie.
I've been waiting all show for this part.
He really has. He's been humming.
Marcus, you've been very quiet over there.
I'm saving my voice, Evelyn. Long night ahead. It's always a long night ahead.
Evelyn, did you finish the crossword during the commercial break again?
In pen, Rosa. Nine across was a good one.
Evelyn, how many rounds of the news have you sat through today?
Enough to know Marcus clears his throat right before every story.
Rosa, someone moved my chair up an inch again.
It wasn't me, Marcus. I think it was the cat.
Marcus, is that a new pair of glasses?
Same glasses, Rosa. I cleaned them. The whole world looks new.
For the record, I'd like it noted that the desk snacks are gone.
Noted, Evelyn. And no, I don't know anything about it.
Batty, no. Batty, that is my coffee. Batty, don't you dare.
And that's the third mug this week. We'll get you a new one, Rosa.
Oh. She's eyeing the pencil cup. Here we go.
Every single pencil. She looked right at the camera, too.
Batty, those are my script pages. Batty. Batty.
Luckily, Rosa knows the whole show by heart. Right, Rosa?
Not the plant, Batty. We just got that plant.
It was nice while it lasted. Someone get a broom out to the desk, please.
And moving in from the south, we have... Pip? Pip, you're on the map!
Sorry, Sunny! He loves a low pressure system. Come back to the lab, Pip.
That pink spot on the map is not a heat wave, folks. That's Pip.
He wanted to see where the rain comes from. It's educational!

birthdays.reply: Thank you, everyone. Marcus, I know you planned something. I can hear it in the hallway.
Please, no singing. I mean it. Okay, a little singing.
Thank you. I'll accept the cake, but I'm still not telling anyone my age.
Thank you! The longest day of the year, and I've got the forecast to prove it.
Right in time for opening week. Best present a guy could ask for.
Thank you, Rosa! They're celebrating with me here, too. Well, they're celebrating something.
Thanks, team! If you see a cupcake in the news van, that one's mine.
Same day as the first moon landing! I'll be taking the whole lab on a trip. To the moon. In spirit.

birthdays.name: Dot Delgado
birthdays.reply: Dot runs our sales desk, so of course she already sold the cake. Happy birthday, Dot!

birthdays.name: Batty
birthdays.reply: Of course it's on Halloween. She's asked for no singing and a lot of tuna.

birthdays.name: Pip
birthdays.reply: He's getting a brand new rock for his tank. He's been staring at it all day.

birthdayOpeners.say: Before we go on, the whole desk wants to wish {name} a very happy birthday.
A quick note from the desk: today is {first}'s birthday. Happy birthday, {first}!

anniversaries.name: Pixel Broadcasting Company
lines: {years} {yearWord} ago today, Pixel Broadcasting Company went on the air.
And we haven't signed off since. Thank you for watching.

anniversaries.name: Juniper Wilde
lines: Today marks {years} {yearWord} since Juniper Wilde joined us on the science desk.
And {years} {yearWord} of glitter in the lab, Rosa. Thank you all!

anniversaries.name: Batty
lines: It's been {years} {yearWord} since our desk cat got her name. Happy Batty day, everyone.
She celebrated by sitting on my script.
